issues.reason: The no-event carve-out of *Where a THING is* is closed — "is located/situated in" plus the bare postural verbs lie/sit/stand/hang/lean/perch/rest — and "appears" is none of them, so the clause is verbal and must reify an event; dropping the lemma and emitting `(LocatedIn sk_phrase_1 sk_ledger_1)` both loses the predicate and asserts a positional containment the clause never predicates.

`Most` encodes the unique maximum and requires the entity's own `(Member <entity> <class>)` companion, so `(Most early sk_ledger_1 ledger)` over-asserts a single earliest ledger for what the text makes a plural set and puts a group witness in a slot whose companion would be false (a group of ledgers is not a ledger).

Names and casing makes a capitalized common noun used as the referent's only label a common noun by default with NO `Name` atom — name-hood requires the capitalized run to exceed the bare class word or a different word to state the kind — and "Watch" is exactly the bare class word.

gaps_confirmed: Textual-occurrence predication ("the phrase appears / occurs / is found in <document>"): it is not on the stative-locative list, and nothing says which head the "in"-PP takes on the reified event (`Location` vs the preposition-named `In`).

Superlative over a PLURAL set ("the earliest surviving ledgers"): `Most` is a unique individual maximum and `AmongMost` is one individual in the top stratum, so a set-denoting superlative has no licensed carrier; a per-member distributed `AmongMost` is the nearest candidate and is unlicensed.

A capitalized bare class word used as a PREMODIFIER ("Watch ledgers"): the capitalized-common-noun default is stated for a definite NP head, and nothing says whether a premodifier falls under it, under the proper-noun-premodifier `Name` + `Possession` route, or under compound fusion (`watch_ledger`).
defect_summary: For "appears", the compliant form reifies the verb — `(Member sk_appear_1 appear) (Experiencer sk_appear_1 sk_phrase_1)` with the ledgers carried by the "in"-PP oblique — and emits no `LocatedIn`, though which oblique head that PP takes is itself the first gap. For "the earliest surviving ... ledgers" NO compliant form is licensed: neither `Most` (a unique individual maximum) nor `AmongMost` (one individual in the top stratum) fits a set-denoting superlative, so the licensed form would have to be a distributed `(Implication (PartOf $x sk_ledger_1) (AmongMost early $x ledger))` or a group-superlative head, and the loss is filed as the second gap. For "Watch", drop `(Name watch "Watch")` and treat it as the capitalized common noun the default makes it, which routes the premodifier through Compound concepts as `watch_ledger` with genus `ledger` and the noun modifier unexposed, rather than the proper-noun `Possession` route.
notes: The phrase's own typing, the definite-plural group witness, and the distributed `surviving` rule (participle-as-modifier kept in adjective form) are all correct.
